records.scope: Existing roundTrip/parity/native verdicts cover the measured single-series Pareto input; they do not establish preservation of arbitrary multi-series source data.
records.detail: Multi-series Pareto keeps only the first numeric series: the four-column North/South/West input re-imports as two columns, with chart-data-adapted / series-dropped. Data preservation remains open (issue 246); no failed native result is inferred.
